description:
crate-jmap-mail-server/Cargo.toml:24 declares `uuid = { version = "1", features = ["v4"] }`. uuid 1.x default features include rng / fast-rng / serde — none required for dev-time tests.

Tightening to `{ version = "1", default-features = false, features = ["v4", "std"] }` would drop transitive deps and slim test build.

Marked opinion. Tiny dev-only change. LOCKED crate (mail-server) — needs approval.
title: P3: workspace inconsistency — uuid dev-dep does not disable defaults
